title: tares factory crew watch --restart --json: what happened to the background watch

action.description: `restarted`: the running watch was stopped and a new one started. `started`: none ran, a new one was started. `none_running`: none ran and `--if-running` was given, so nothing was started. `other_install`: the watch runs from a program outside the `--only-under` folder, so it was left alone.

pid.description: The new watch's process id. Absent when nothing was started.

executable.description: The program the running watch was started from. Only with `other_install`.
